verdict.rationale: BigQuery publishes a pricing page describing two compute models: on-demand billing per TiB processed with the first 1 TiB free each month, and capacity billing via reserved slots measured over time. The monthly free tier of 10 GiB storage and 1 TiB of queries is also stated. Community users confirm a dry-run option and a bytes-to-be-scanned preview for estimating cost before running a query, but others say the TB-scanned and slot abstractions make costs hard to predict, and one user reports an unexpected $14,000 bill. missing for 10: documented storage and slot unit rates and a pricing calculator in the evidence, plus clearer guidance that removes community confusion about how bills accrue.
